_why: Owner, 14 Oct 2026: a reel that rebuilds a reference reel almost as-is is plagiarism. Parts that came from studying a specific reel the owner shared are tagged with that reel. check.mjs allows at most ONE such part per reference in a film, never one as the payoff/big moment, and refuses the reference's own lines (bannedPhrases). Learn the timing and the idea, then combine it with our own parts.
